claim: On a redundant synthetic plant log, the tier-0 companion (dedup, cache, deterministic lookup, escalation on conflict) cuts a local 1.5B model's tokens 13.9x and total wall time 21x, with accuracy no more than one question below the model alone and all plain lookups correct; guessing on conflicts and random pruning both lose accuracy.
limits: Synthetic log built with redundancy; one model (qwen2.5-1.5b q4_k_m, CPU); seed 3 lost one aggregate question the baseline got; tier 0 only.
